subject: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@inflight.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions

Team — thanks for a productive cross-functional sync earlier. I captured a consolidated workqueue and highlighted items that need exec-level clarity for the upcoming QBR. Quick summary and asks below: 

1) Outstanding exec asks (need a clear owner by EOD Tue):
   - Pricing credit policy for early Dedicated renewals (Aditya: confirm floor / cap)
   - SLA exception for APAC pilot (region ops constraints; Vivek to advise fallback)

2) Roadmap exceptions flagged by Product: two features (KV cache persistence + multi-tenancy routing) are at risk for Q3 ship because of infra dependencies. Product needs prioritized guidance — timeline or defer? (Maya to synthesize impact)

3) Procurement / SOC2 request: InFlight procurement asked for additional evidence; I flagged SOC2 artifacts we can share but we need sign-off to release audit screenshots. (Lauren — procurement support)

Attachments: workqueue_tracker_20270418.csv (live tracker), QBR_exec_asks_v2.xlsx (proposal).

Ask: please reply with the single-line owner + target date for any items you’re taking. If you think an item should be escalated to execs instead of being resolved at manager level, mark it with [ESCALATE].

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions

Vanessa — thanks. A quick clarification from Product on the two exceptions: 

- KV cache persistence: engineering estimates a 6-week effort if we parallelize with the model runtime team; risk is primarily around regression on memory; impact = medium-high for low-latency workloads. Suggest: either (A) commit to 6-week engineering window and defer other infra optimizations, or (B) delay to Q4 and apply temporary heuristics in routing.

- Multi-tenancy routing: blocker is vendor library compatibility with our kernel selection layer; more likely a 10-week effort with cross-team coordination. Impact = high for Dedicated customers wanting isolated routing guarantees.

I’m marking KV cache persistence as [ESCALATE] because we don’t have runway to both complete that and the pre-QBR demo sanitize pass. I added notes to the attached tracker row ~ line 8.

Maya
Director, Product Management

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@inflight.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions

Thanks for surfacing, team. Priorities from my side:

- Pricing credit policy: we will not set precedent for blanket credits. For early Dedicated renewals, allow one-time prorated credit up to 6% of committed spend for strategic customers. Aditya-owner; ETA: 2027-04-21 EOD.

- KV cache persistence: I agree to escalate. Given Product’s assessment, route to execs — this affects our QBR narrative. Marked [ESCALATE].

- SOC2 evidence release: we must redact user-identifying fields and run legal review before sending. Lauren / Legal to confirm redaction checklist by 2027-04-20.

Aditya
VP, Revenue & GTM

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, CloudOps <cloudops@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions

Updating owners and timelines (added to tracker):

- Pricing credit policy — Owner: Aditya Rao — Due: 2027-04-21 (confirmed)
- SOC2 evidence redaction & handoff — Owner: Lauren Bishop + Legal — Due: 2027-04-20 (Lauren: can you confirm you have access to the artifacts?)
- KV cache persistence [ESCALATE] — Owner: Maya Srinivasan (Product) to prepare exec brief + impact matrix — Due: 2027-04-22
- Multi-tenancy routing — Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Infra) — Proposed due: 2027-06-01 (parallel planning phase)
- InFlight procurement: Sarah Jenkins asked for a vendor security checklist and deployment topology. Owner: Vanessa Ortiz + CloudOps contact (cc'd) — Due: 2027-04-23

Note: CloudOps from Acme — please confirm compatibility notes on multi-tenancy routing library by EOD Fri so we can lock vendor risk.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (redaction request from InFlight), updated workqueue_tracker_20270418.csv (rows updated).

Grace O'Connor
Head, Customer Reliability

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@inflight.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: operational workqueue + QBR prep — exec asks & exceptions

Acknowledged — I’ll put an initial vendor-compatibility note into JIRA INF-3421 today and ask CloudOps (Acme) for a short compatibility checklist. My team can start the planning runbook for multi-tenancy routing in parallel; I’ll aim to have a scoping doc by 2027-05-10.

Also attaching a lightweight tracker export (workqueue_tracker_20270418.csv) with the updated owners and due dates. If anyone needs me to pull metric run rates (latency/cost delta) for the QBR deck, call it out and I’ll prioritize extraction.

— Vivek
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
